paragraphs: Privia Health Group, Inc. ("Privia Health", "we", "our", or the "Company") is a technology-driven, national physician-enablement company that collaborates with physician practices, health plans, and health systems to achieve the quadruple aim of better outcomes, lower costs, improved patient experience, and happier and more engaged providers. We seek to accomplish the quadruple aim by entering markets and organizing existing physicians and non-physician clinicians into a unique practice model that combines the advantages of a partnership in a large regional medical group (each, a "Medical Group") with significant provider autonomy for the physicians (collectively, "Privia Physicians") and non-physician clinicians (collectively "Privia Clinicians" and, together with the Privia Physicians, the "Privia Providers") in our Medical Groups.

We organize physicians into cost efficient, value-based and primary-care centric networks bolstered by strong physician governance, and promote a culture of physician leadership. Our technology and service solutions (collectively, the "Privia Platform") are powered by our Privia Technology Solution that integrates both Privia-developed and third-party applications into a seamless interface and workflow that manages all aspects of our Privia Providers' provision of healthcare services. We enhance the patient experience, improve practice economics and influence point of care delivery through investments in data analytics, revenue cycle management ("RCM"), practice and clinical operations and payer alignment. The Privia Platform is designed to succeed across demographic cohorts, acuity levels and reimbursement models, including traditional fee-for-service Medicare, the Medicare Shared Savings Program ("MSSP"), Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial insurance and other existing and emerging direct contracting programs with payers and employers.

We designed the Privia Platform to be scalable, allowing us to grow our presence in new geographic markets and guide those markets from fee-for-service ("FFS") to value-based care ("VBC"), including commercial risk, by shifting the reimbursement model and helping our Privia Providers better manage the cost of care through a focus on quality and success-based reimbursement. Our business model is designed to have meaningful revenue visibility, with low invested capital and attractive margin opportunity. We believe the Privia Platform aligns with the direction healthcare is headed, including (1) a macro shift towards VBC models that focus on delivering coordinated, high quality care at lower total costs, (2) a greater focus on the patient experience and (3) a focus on optimizing provider workflow and bringing back the joy of practicing medicine. Our value proposition and comprehensive solution set address needs across the spectrum of physician practices.
We believe the Privia Platform is differentiated and well positioned to drive sustainable long-term growth because it:
•Addresses a large and growing total addressable market ("TAM") of providers
•Incorporates a flexible model that is purpose-built to scale nationally by facilitating the entrance into new markets with multiple types of physician practices

•Built on a comprehensive cloud-based technology-enabled platform that is designed to optimize provider workflow across the full continuum of reimbursement environments in virtual and in-person care settings
•Focused on establishing scaled provider groups across each geographical market, resulting in increased relevance with payers and patients
•Designed to transition care delivery in each market from FFS to VBC and to enhance the ability of Privia Providers to manage higher risk patients
•Reduces administrative burden and generally increases provider profitability for community providers
•Led by a team with significant experience leading payer, provider and healthcare information technology organizations

We currently have a presence in 24 states and the District of Columbia, including 9 states in which we only participate in VBC arrangements. Generally speaking, we define a market as a geographic area covered by one of our Medical Groups under a single Tax ID Number ("TIN"). A market could comprise a single state, a part of a state or a group of multiple states and/or districts. We aim to build relationships with key constituents including physicians, non-physician clinicians, patients, government programs, commercial payers and employers. As of December 31, 2025, we had 5,380 Privia Providers who are credentialed and bill for medical services, in both Owned and Non-Owned Medical Groups (as defined below), ("implemented providers"). Our implemented providers operate in over 1,300 practice locations. Privia cares for over 5.8 million patients, including in VBC arrangements approximately 910,000 commercial patients, as measured at the end of a particular period ("attributed lives"), approximately 212,000 Medicare Advantage attributed lives, 298,000 Medicare Shared Savings / Maryland PCP+ Program attributed lives, and approximately 120,000 Medicaid attributed lives. In some instances, we also move into and expand in new and existing markets through our Privia Care Partners model, which offers an affiliation model to providers who are looking solely for VBC solutions. For those practices, we furnish population health services, reporting and analytics, along with certain management services.

Under our Privia Medical Group model, Privia Physicians join the Medical Group in their geographic market as an owner of the Medical Group. We own a majority interest in certain of our Medical Groups (each, an "Owned Medical Group"), with Privia Physicians collectively owning a minority interest, and we own no interest in certain other Medical Groups for which we provide services through a services agreement (each, a "Non-Owned Medical Group"). In those markets in which state regulations prohibit us from owning Medical Groups, the Non-Owned Medical Groups may be owned by the Privia Physicians or majority owned indirectly by a licensed physician holding a Privia leadership position (each such Non-Owned Medical Group owned in this manner, a "Friendly Medical Group") with Privia Physicians collectively owning a minority interest. In certain markets where we partner with health systems, our health system partner owns a majority interest in the Non-Owned Medical Groups, with Privia Physicians owning a minority interest. Privia Physicians furnish healthcare services through our Medical Groups and continue to own their historical practice entities ("Affiliated Practices"), which provide certain services to the Medical Groups, such as use of space, non-physician staffing, equipment and supplies.

We provide management services to the Medical Groups though local management services organizations (each, an "MSO"), which provide Medical Groups with access to VBC opportunities either directly or through Privia-owned accountable care organizations (each, an "ACO"). We have national committees that distribute quality guidance, and we employ Chief Medical Officers who provide clinical oversight and direction over the clinical affairs of the Owned Medical Groups. Additionally, we hold the provider contracts, maintain the patient records, set reimbursement rates, and negotiate payer contracts on behalf of the Owned Medical Groups.

Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
Risks associated with VBC arrangements may negatively impact our business, operations, and financial condition.
An increase in the volume of uninsured patients or deterioration in the collectability of patient responsibility accounts could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
The reimbursement process is complex and may involve delays and other uncertainties, which may adversely affect our business, operations, cash flows, revenues, and earnings.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information contained in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes thereto, before making a decision to invest in our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. It is not possible to predict or identify all such factors. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that affect us. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, operating results and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment.
The following is a summary of risk factors that could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

•We conduct business in a heavily regulated industry, which increases our costs and could restrict the conduct of our business, and if the Company or our Medical Groups fail to comply with the extensive applicable healthcare laws and government regulations, which may change from time to time, we could suffer adverse financial impacts, be required to make significant changes to our operations, or experience reputational harm, any or all of which may adversely affect our business.

•Our business model relies on a complex legal framework that governs our relationships with Medical Groups and Privia Providers. Legal challenges or shifting interpretations of applicable laws could require us to make significant changes to our operations, which could adversely affect our business.

•Our business, financial condition and results of operations may be adversely affected by changes and uncertainty in the healthcare industry, including health reform initiatives and other changes to laws and regulations.
•We, our Medical Groups and Privia Providers, may be subject to legal proceedings, including litigation, governmental investigations and claims, and payer audits.

We recognize revenue from multiple stakeholders, including health care consumers, health insurers, employers, providers and health systems. Our revenue includes (i) FFS revenue generated from providing healthcare services to patients through Privia Providers of Owned Medical Groups or administrative fees collected for providing administrative services to Non-Owned Medical Groups, (ii) VBC revenue collected on behalf of our providers, primarily capitated revenue, shared savings (including surplus payments, shared savings, total cost of care budget payments and similar payments) and PMPM fees (including care management fees, management services fees, care coordination fees and all other similar administrative fees), and (iii) other revenue from additional services, such as concierge services, virtual visits, virtual scribes and coding.

paragraphs: Privia Health Group, Inc. ("Privia Health", "we", "our", or the "Company") 為一項以科技為驅動力的國家級醫師支援公司，與醫師診所、健康保險計劃及醫療系統合作，以實現四重目標：改善醫療結果、降低醫療成本、提升患者體驗，以及讓醫師與非醫師醫療專業人員更開心且更具參與感。我們透過進入新市場，並組織現有醫師與非醫師醫療專業人員，形成獨特的診所模式，結合大型區域醫療集團（每個稱為 "Medical Group"）的合作優勢，同時給予醫師（ collectively, "Privia Physicians"）與非醫師醫療專業人員（ collectively "Privia Clinicians" and, together with the Privia Physicians, the "Privia Providers"）在醫療集團內高度的自主權。

我們將醫師組織成成本效益高、以價值為導向且以門診醫療為中心的網路，並強化醫師治理，促進醫師領導文化的建立。我們的科技與服務解決方案（ collectively, the "Privia Platform"）由 Privia Technology Solution 驅動，整合 Privia 自行開發與第三方應用程式，形成無縫的介面與工作流程，以管理 Privia Providers 提供醫療服務的各項事務。我們透過投資資料分析、收入週期管理（"RCM"）、診所與臨牀運作及保險商對接，來提升患者體驗、改善診所經濟效益並影響臨牀照護的執行。Privia Platform 設計用以成功應對不同人口統計羣體、病情嚴重程度與報酬模式，包括傳統按服務計費的 Medicare、Medicare 共享節省計畫（"MSSP"）、Medicare Advantage、Medicaid、商業保險及其他現有與新興的直接 contracting 計畫與保險商及僱主。

我們設計 Privia Platform 以具備擴展性，使我們能在新地理區域市場擴大影響力，並引導這些市場從按服務計費（"FFS"）轉向以價值為導向的照護（"VBC"），包括商業風險，透過轉變報酬模式，協助 Privia Providers 更有效地管理照護成本，透過重視品質與以成功為基礎的報酬模式。我們的商業模式設計為具備明確的收入可見度，投資資本低且有吸引力的毛利率機會。我們相信 Privia Platform 與醫療照護的發展方向一致，包括（1）總體經濟趨向以價值為導向的照護模式，專注於提供協調且高品質的照護，同時降低總體成本；（2）更重視患者體驗；（3）優化醫療專業人員的工作流程，並重新找回從事醫療工作的樂趣。我們的價值主張與完整的解決方案組合，可覆蓋各類醫師診所的需求。
我們相信 Privia Platform 具備差異化優勢，且處於推動可持續長期成長的有利位置，因為它：
• 覆蓋一個規模龐大且持續成長的總可達市場（"TAM"）的醫療專業人員
• 融合一種靈活的模式，專為全國擴展而設計，透過協助進入新市場與多種類型的醫師診所，實現擴張
• 建立在一個全面的雲端科技驅動平台之上，設計用以優化醫療專業人員的工作流程，適用於虛擬與實體照護環境中的所有報酬環境
• 聚焦於在每個地理市場建立規模化的醫療專業人員羣組，進而提高與保險商及患者的相關性
•設計用以在各市場將照護交付模式從按服務計費（FFS）轉變為價值-based照護（VBC），並提升 Privia 提供者管理高風險病患的能力
•降低行政負擔，並一般性地提高社區提供者的營運利潤
•由具備豐富經驗領導支付者、提供者及醫療資訊科技組織的團隊領導

本公司目前在 24 個州及華盛頓特區有據點，包括 9 個州僅參與價值基準契約（VBC）安排。總體而言，本公司將市場定義為由我們的醫療羣體（Medical Groups）覆蓋的地理區域，並以單一稅務識別號碼（"TIN"）為依據。一個市場可能涵蓋單一州、州內的一部分或多個州及/或地區。本公司旨在與關鍵相關方建立關係，包括醫師、非醫師臨牀人員、患者、政府計畫、商業保險機構及僱主。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司有 5,380 名 Privia 提供者，這些提供者已取得認證並為醫療服務開立帳單，包括 Owned 及 Non-Owned 醫療羣體（如下所定）（"已實施提供者"）。本公司已實施提供者經營超過 1,300 個實務場所。Privia 照顧超過 5.8 百萬名患者，包括在 VBC 安排中約 910,000 名商業患者，以特定期間結束時的數據（"歸屬生命"）計算，約 212,000 名 Medicare Advantage 歸屬生命，298,000 名 Medicare 共享節省 / 馬裏蘭州 PCP+ 程式歸屬生命，以及約 120,000 名 Medicaid 歸屬生命。在某些情況下，本公司也透過 Privia Care Partners 模式進入並擴展至新舊市場，該模式為僅尋求 VBC 解決方案的提供者提供加盟模式。對這些實務，本公司提供人口健康服務、報告與分析，以及某些管理服務。

根據我們的 Privia 醫療羣體模型，Privia 醫師在其地理市場加入醫療羣體作為醫療羣體的所有者。我們在部分醫療羣體（每個稱為 "Owned 醫療羣體"）中擁有大多數權益，Privia 醫師集體擁有少數權益，而在其他醫療羣體中我們不持有任何權益，我們透過服務協議為這些醫療羣體提供服務（每個稱為 "Non-Owned 醫療羣體"）。在州法規禁止我們擁有醫療羣體的市場中，Non-Owned 醫療羣體可能由 Privia 醫師擁有，或間接由持有 Privia 領導職位的執照醫師擁有（每個如此擁有 Non-Owned 醫療羣體稱為 "Friendly 醫療羣體"），Privia 醫師集體擁有少數權益。在某些與醫療系統合作的市場中，我們的醫療系統合作夥伴擁有 Non-Owned 醫療羣體的大多數權益，Privia 醫師擁有少數權益。Privia 醫師透過我們的醫療羣體提供醫療服務，並繼續擁有其歷史實務機構（"附屬實務"），這些機構為醫療羣體提供某些服務，例如空間使用、非醫師人力、設備與用品。

我們透過本地管理服務組織（每個稱為 "MSO"）為醫療羣體提供管理服務，這些組織為醫療羣體提供接觸 VBC 機會的管道，或是透過 Privia 擁有的 accountable care 組織（每個稱為 "ACO"）。我們有全國性的委員會分發品質指引，我們聘僱首席醫療官，為 Owned 醫療羣體的臨牀事務提供臨牀監督與指導。此外，我們持有提供者契約、維護患者記錄、設定報酬率，並代表 Owned 醫療羣體與支付者協商契約。

paragraphs: 請配合閱讀我們的合併財務報表及附註，這些內容包含於本年度10-K申報表的其他部分。此外，以下討論與分析以及資訊包含有關本公司業務、營運及財務表現的預測性陳述，基於我們目前的預期，這些陳述涉及風險、不確定性與假設。我們的實際結果可能與這些預測性陳述所預期的有重大差異，原因可能包括，但不僅限於，以下所列及本年度10-K申報表中「風險因素」與「預測性陳述資訊」部分所討論的那些因素。
Privia Health為一項以科技為驅動的國家級醫師支援公司，與醫師診所、健康保險計畫及醫療系統合作，以實現改善結果、降低成本、提升患者體驗及讓醫師更開心且更投入的四重目標。我們透過進入市場並組織現有醫師與非醫師醫療專業人員，形成獨特的診所模式，來達成四重目標，此模式結合了大型區域醫療集團的合作優勢與對Privia醫師加入醫療集團的顯著自主權。

根據我們的Privia醫療集團模式，Privia醫師在其地理市場加入醫療集團，成為醫療集團的股東。我們在部分醫療集團中擁有過半數股權，Privia醫師則 collectively 擁有少數股權，而在其他非自有醫療集團中，我們則不持有任何股權。在那些州政府法規不允許我們擁有醫療集團的市場，非自有醫療集團可能由Privia醫師擁有，或間接由持有Privia領導職位的經證照醫師擁有，否則稱為友善醫療集團。Privia醫師透過我們的醫療集團提供醫療服務，並繼續擁有其附屬診所，這些附屬診所提供某些服務給醫療集團，例如空間使用、非醫師人力、設備與用品。
我們透過當地MSO提供醫療集團管理服務，使醫療集團能直接或透過Privia所有的ACO取得價值-based 照護（VBC）機會。我們設有全國性委員會，分發品質指引，並聘請首席醫療官，為自有醫療集團的臨牀事務提供臨牀監督與指導。此外，我們持有提供者契約、維護病患記錄、設定報酬率，並代表自有醫療集團與支付者洽談契約。
在某些情況下，我們也透過Privia Care Partners模式進入並擴展至新市場與現有市場，此模式為僅尋求VBC解決方案的提供者提供一種合作模式。對這些診所，我們提供人口健康服務、報告與分析，以及某些管理服務。

我們從多個利害關係人取得收入，包括醫療消費者、健康保險公司、僱主、提供者及醫療系統。我們的收入包括 (i) 經由 Privia Providers of Owned Medical Groups 或行政費用收取，為患者提供醫療服務所產生的 FFS 收入，以及為非 Owned Medical Groups 提供行政服務所收取的行政費用；(ii) 為我們的提供者收取的 VBC 收入，主要包括資本化收入、共享節省（包括盈餘支付、共享節省、總醫療成本預算支付及類似支付）及 PMPM 費用（包括照護管理費用、管理服務費用、照護協調費用及所有其他類似行政費用）；(iii) 其他收入來自額外服務，例如管家服務、虛擬會診、虛擬速記及編碼服務。

headings: 本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能因醫療產業的變化與不確定性而受到負面影響，包括健康改革措施及其他法律與法規的變更。
本公司、醫療羣組及Privia提供者可能面臨法律程序，包括訴訟、政府調查及聲請，以及付款方審計。
與本公司業務及營運相關的風險
與價值基準（VBC）安排相關的風險可能對本公司業務、營運及財務狀況產生負面影響。
無保險患者人數增加或患者責任賬戶的收款能力惡化，可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。
報酬程序複雜，可能涉及延遲及其他不確定性，這可能對本公司業務、營運、現金流、營業收入及獲利產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本報告中所有其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註，再做投資決策。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。無法預測或識別所有這些因素。我們可能還會面臨一些我們未察覺，或目前認為不具重大影響的風險與不確定性，這些因素也可能成為影響我們的重要因素。若任何下列風險發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
下列為可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果造成重大且不利影響的風險因素摘要。
•我們從事的行業屬於高度管制產業，這會增加我們的成本，並可能限制我們的業務運作。若本公司或我們的醫療集團未能遵守適用的廣泛醫療法規與政府規範（這些規範可能隨時變更），我們可能面臨財務損失，必須對營運進行重大調整，或遭受聲譽損害，任何一種或全部情況都可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
•我們的業務模式依賴於一套複雜的法律架構，用以規範我們與醫療集團及Privia提供者之間的關係。法律挑戰或適用法律的解釋變動，可能導致我們必須對營運進行重大調整，這可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
•我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果可能因醫療產業的變化與不確定性而受到不利影響，包括醫療改革計畫及其他法律與規範的變更。
•本公司、我們的醫療集團及Privia提供者可能面臨法律訴訟、政府調查與聲請，以及付款方審計。
